roles.drugs: outpatient: ciprofloxacin 500 mg BID x7 days or levofloxacin 750 mg daily x5-7 days

inpatient: IV ciprofloxacin or levofloxacin, or IV ceftriaxone. IDSA 2025 suggests choosing empirically by severity of illness, risk factors for resistant uropathogens and patient-specific considerations (local antibiogram if available, in sepsis), and avoiding an FQ if one was used in the past 12 months
